from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, math, os, statistics, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
repo = Path.cwd()
expected_sha = 'dd41b5227acd7c41a9a815ccbf84ab074707144b'
observed_sha = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert observed_sha == expected_sha
subject = repo / 'tests' / 'test_wp900_wp206_two_process_restart.py'
subject_blob = subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object',str(subject)], text=True).strip()
iterations = 30
latencies = []
stdout_hashes = []
stderr_hashes = []
for i in range(iterations):
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','-q','tests.test_wp900_wp206_two_process_restart'], cwd=repo, env=os.environ.copy(), text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter_ns() - started
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print(json.dumps({'schema':'F2_WP903_BOUNDED_SOAK_CANDIDATE/v1','status':'PRODUCT_NEGATIVE','iteration':i,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout[-4000:],'stderr':p.stderr[-4000:],'f2_source_sha':observed_sha,'test_blob_sha':subject_blob,'runtime_credit':0,'whole_system_acceptance':False}, sort_keys=True))
        raise SystemExit(41)
    latencies.append(elapsed)
    stdout_hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest())
    stderr_hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(p.stderr.encode()).hexdigest())
def pct(values, q):
    s=sorted(values); idx=max(0,min(len(s)-1,math.ceil(q*len(s))-1)); return s[idx]
first = statistics.median(latencies[:10])
last = statistics.median(latencies[-10:])
ratio_ppm = int(last * 1_000_000 / first) if first else 0
payload = {
 'schema':'F2_WP903_BOUNDED_SOAK_CANDIDATE/v1',
 'status':'EXECUTED_NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE',
 'classification':'REVIEW_ONLY_CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER_EXACT_SOURCE_S1_RESTART_CRASH_SOAK',
 'trigger':'4',
 'candidate_workpackage':'F2-WP-903',
 'mutation_authority':False,
 'f2_source_sha':observed_sha,
 'test_path':'tests/test_wp900_wp206_two_process_restart.py',
 'test_blob_sha':subject_blob,
 'iterations':iterations,
 'fresh_process_and_post_commit_crash_cases_per_iteration':2,
 'total_test_cases':iterations*2,
 'latency_ns_min':min(latencies),
 'latency_ns_p50':int(statistics.median(latencies)),
 'latency_ns_p95':pct(latencies,0.95),
 'latency_ns_max':max(latencies),
 'first10_median_ns':int(first),
 'last10_median_ns':int(last),
 'last_vs_first_median_ratio_ppm':ratio_ppm,
 'unique_stdout_hashes':len(set(stdout_hashes)),
 'unique_stderr_hashes':len(set(stderr_hashes)),
 'runtime_execution_observed':True,
 'candidate_soak_evidence_observed':True,
 'runtime_credit':0,
 'vps_runtime_credit':0,
 'physical_host_credit':0,
 'grid10_runtime_credit':0,
 'gwt_runtime_credit':0,
 'jspace_runtime_credit':0,
 'effect_credit':0,
 'completion_credit':0,
 'training_credit':0,
 'whole_system_acceptance':False,
 'evidence_law':'Bounded repeated execution of the already-accepted restart/crash component discriminator only; no canonical WP903 promotion until separately reconciled under current F2 claim/event law.'
}
print(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True))
